name: RLSProof
dataSource: User-supplied public GitHub repository plus the public GitHub REST API
limitations: Quick Scan is intentionally bounded to public repositories, native static checks, at most 18 selected files, 128 KiB per file, 1 MiB total scanned content, 5,000 tree entries and repositories up to 50,000 KiB. Unauthenticated GitHub API rate limits apply; private repositories and full external-scanner coverage are not supported in the browser Quick Scan.

description.tr: Herkese açık GitHub depolarında Supabase RLS ve yetkilendirme risklerini sınırlı tarayıcı tabanlı kontrollerle inceleyin.
description.en: Scan public GitHub repositories for bounded Supabase RLS and authorization risks with deterministic browser-side checks.
